figure_goal: Explain the distinct roles of neuron, astrocyte, and microglia in brain waste clearance.
paper_claim: Microglia perform phagocytic clearance, while astrocytes support extracellular homeostasis, signaling, and soluble/perivascular clearance around neurons.

panels.name: Three-cell clearance mechanism
panels.content: Astrocyte support and soluble route; neuron context; microglial engulfment and lysosomal degradation.
